title: Smoky Grilled Skewers with Slovakian Kissed Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring tender skewers of meat, infused with the warmth of Slovakian kissed spices and a hint of smokiness.
instructions: Thread beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small gap between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together Slovakian kissed spice blend and smoky paprika.
Brush skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic.
Sprinkle date pieces over the beef on the skewers.
Sprinkle the spice blend mixture evenly over the skewers.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until beef reaches desired doneness.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
